title: Fixed Open Tapered Windsock and Mouth Hoop Mast
description: One newly authored complete fixed extended windsock display with its own broad flat base and full tall mast, upper sleeve and branching mouth-hoop supports. A continuous thick tapered fabric-style shell follows a lightly sagged centreline, with real inner wall, full finite end rims and genuinely open large mouth and small tail. The independent circular mouth hoop supports the whole upper cuff; no cap or opaque disc fakes either opening. This is not a rigid arrow vane or a three-cup rotor rematerialized, and no old numeric mesh is imported. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and horizontal-envelope centred ground datum. Static illustrative exterior only: no actual wind response, free rotation, cloth simulation, aerodynamic or weather measurement, flight, mounting compatibility, load, structural or safety capability.
